using namespace std;

class IntList {
public:
    vector<int> data;
    int size = 0;

    IntList() {
        data.assign(3, 0);
    }

    bool isEmpty() {
        return size == 0;
    }

    int get(int index) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) {
            throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        }
        return data[index];
    }

    void clear() {
        size = 0;
    }

    void set(int index, int value) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) {
            throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        }
        data[index] = value;
    }

    void expand() {
        if (size >= (int)data.size()) {
            data.resize((data.size() << 1) + 1);
        }
    }

    void insert(int index, int value) {
        if (index < 0 || index > size) {
            throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        }
        expand();
        data.insert(data.begin() + index, value);
        ++size;
    }

    int deleteAt(int index) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) {
            throw out_of_range("Index out of bounds");
        }
        int value = data[index];
        data.erase(data.begin() + index);
        --size;
        return value;
    }

    void push(int value) {
        expand();
        if (size >= (int)data.size()) {
            data.resize((data.size() << 1) + 1);
        }
        data.emplace_back(value);
        ++size;
    }

    int pop() {
        if (size == 0) {
            throw exception();
        }
        int val = data[size - 1];
        --size;
        data.pop_back();
        return val;
    }

    void unshift(int value) {
        expand();
        data.insert(data.begin(), value);
        ++size;
    }

    int shift() {
        if (size == 0) {
            throw exception();
        }
        int val = data[0];
        data.erase(data.begin());
        --size;
        return val;
    }
};

class IntIntMap {
public:
    static const int EMPTY = INT_MIN;
    vector<int> data;
    int size = 0;
    int capacity;

    IntIntMap() {
        data.assign(4, 0);
        data[0] = EMPTY;
        data[2] = EMPTY;
        capacity = 4;
    }

    bool isEmpty() {
        return size == 0;
    }

    int getSize() {
        return size;
    }

    void clear() {
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)data.size(); i += 2) {
            data[i] = EMPTY;
        }
        size = 0;
    }

    static int hash(int key) {
        int hash_value = static_cast<long long>(key) * 1000000007;
        hash_value ^= (hash_value >> 16);
        hash_value ^= (hash_value >> 24);
        return hash_value;
    }

    bool have(int key) {
        if (key == EMPTY) {
            throw invalid_argument("Key cannot be EMPTY");
        }
        int mask = (capacity - 2);
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) {
                return true;
            } else if (cur == EMPTY) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return false; // should never reach here
    }

    int get(int key, int default_) {
        if (key == EMPTY) {
            throw invalid_argument("Key cannot be EMPTY");
        }
        int mask = (capacity - 2);
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) {
                return data[i + 1];
            } else if (cur == EMPTY) {
                return default_;
            }
        }
        return default_; // should never reach here
    }

    static vector<int> resize(const vector<int>& old_data, int new_capacity) {
        vector<int> ndata(new_capacity, EMPTY);
        int old_capacity = old_data.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < old_capacity; i += 2) {
            int cur = old_data[i];
            if (cur == EMPTY) {
                continue;
            }
            int mask = new_capacity - 2;
            for (int j = hash(cur) & mask;; j = (j - 1) & mask) {
                if (ndata[j] == EMPTY) {
                    ndata[j] = cur;
                    ndata[j + 1] = old_data[i + 1];
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        return ndata;
    }

    void set(int key, int value) {
        if (key == EMPTY) {
            throw invalid_argument("Key cannot be EMPTY");
        }
        int cap = (int)data.size();
        int mask = cap - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) {
                data[i + 1] = value;
                return;
            } else if (cur == EMPTY) {
                data[i] = key;
                data[i + 1] = value;
                if (++size > cap / 4) {
                    data = resize(data, cap << 1);
                }
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    void deleteKey(int key) {
        if (key == EMPTY) {
            throw invalid_argument("Key cannot be EMPTY");
        }
        int cap = (int)data.size();
        int mask = cap - 2;
        for (int i = hash(key) & mask;; i = (i - 1) & mask) {
            int cur = data[i];
            if (cur == key) {
                for (int j = i;;) {
                    int next = data[(j - 1) & mask];
                    if (next == EMPTY) {
                        data[j] = EMPTY;
                        --size;
                        return;
                    }
                    int k = hash(next) & mask;
                    bool cond = (k >= i) != (k < (j - 1) & mask) != (i < (j - 1) & mask);
                    if (cond) {
                        data[j] = next;
                        data[j + 1] = data[((j - 1) & mask) + 1];
                        j = (j - 1) & mask;
                    } else {
                        --j;
                    }
                }
            } else if (cur == EMPTY) {
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    void expand(int newCapacity) {
        if ((int)data.size() / 4 < newCapacity) {
            data = resize(data, max((int)pow(2, (int)ceil(log2(newCapacity)))), 4);
        }
    }

    void shrink() {
        int oldCapacity = (int)data.size();
        if (oldCapacity > 4 && oldCapacity >> 3 >= size) {
            int newCap = max((int)pow(2, (int)ceil(log2(size))), 4);
            data = resize(data, newCap);
        }
    }
};

static vector<IntList*> freeLists;

static IntList* takeList() {
    if (freeLists.empty()) {
        return new IntList();
    } else {
        IntList* l = freeLists.back();
        freeLists.pop_back();
        return l;
    }
}

static void putList(IntList* list) {
    list->clear();
    freeLists.push_back(list);
}

static int n, m;

static IntList* solve(int from, int to) {
    IntList* res;
    if (from + 1 == to) {
        res = takeList();
        res->push(from);
        if (from + m > n) {
            res->push(n - from);
            res->push(from - n);
        }
        res->push(m);
        if (from > m) {
            res->push(n - from);
            res->push(from);
        }
        res->push(-from);
    } else {
        int mid = (from + to) >> 1;
        IntList* a = solve(from, mid);
        IntList* b = solve(mid, to);
        res = takeList();
        int aSize = a->size;
        int bSize = b->size;
        int* aData = a->data.data();
        int* bData = b->data.data();
        for (int i = 0;; i += 2) {
            int bFrom = (i == 0) ? 0 : bData[i - 1];
            int bTo_ = (i == bSize - 1) ? n : bData[i + 1];
            int bShift = bData[i];
            int aFrom = bFrom + bShift;
            int aTo_ = bTo_ + bShift;
            int l = 0, r = aSize - 1;
            while (l < r) {
                int m_ = (((l + r) >> 2) << 1) + 1;
                if (aData[m_] <= aFrom) {
                    l = m_ + 1;
                } else {
                    r = m_ - 1;
                }
            }
            int cur = l;
            while (true) {
                res->push(bShift + aData[cur]);
                ++cur;
                if (cur == aSize) break;
                int pos = aData[cur];
                if (pos >= aTo_) break;
                res->push(pos - bShift);
                ++cur;
            }
            if (i == bSize - 1) break;
            res->push(bTo_);
        }
        delete a;
        delete b;
    }
    return res;
}

static void solve() {
    cin >> n >> m;
    int s;
    cin >> s;
    long long t;
    cin >> t;
    s -= 1;
    long long t_mod = t % n;
    for (long long ct = t_mod; ct != 0; ct--) {
        if (s < m) {
            s += 1;
            if (s >= n) s -= n;
        } else {
            s -= 1;
            if (s < 0) s += n;
        }
    }
    long long cycles = t / n;
    if (cycles > 0) {
        IntList* cycleSolve = solve(0, n);
        int csSize = cycleSolve->size;
        int* csData = cycleSolve->data.data();
        IntList* cycleList = takeList();
        IntIntMap cycleMap;
        for (int it = 0;; it++) {
            if (it == cycles) break;
            int prev = cycleMap.get(s, -1);
            if (prev >= 0) {
                s = cycleList->get(prev + (int)((cycles - prev) % (it - prev)));
                break;
            }
            cycleList->push(s);
            cycleMap.set(s, it);
            int l = 0, r = csSize - 1;
            while (l < r) {
                int m_ = (((l + r) >> 2) << 1) + 1;
                if (csData[m_] <= s) {
                    l = m_ + 1;
                } else {
                    r = m_ - 1;
                }
            }
            s += csData[l];
        }
        delete cycleSolve;
        putList(cycleList);
    }
    cout << s + 1 << endl;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    try {
        solve();
    } catch (...) {
        cerr << "Exception occurred" << endl;
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
